season_context.local_season_notes: Autumn is cooling into a wet, cold winter, colder inland, so outerwear, knits and suede are in season. Ramadan is expected to start around February 2027 and Eid around early March, a key time for modest and festive buying. Spring/summer 2027 sourcing starts at the February 2027 trade fairs.

sources.title: IFCO Feb 2026 edition confirms Istanbul's position
Ticaret Bakanı Bolat: 2026 tekstil ve giyimde toparlanma yılı oldu

trends.name: Oversized checks on airy skirts
trends.summary: Autumn checks are larger and bolder than last year, often on floaty skirts styled with ruffled blouses and soft knitwear for a boho feel.

trends.name: Snake and zebra prints
trends.summary: Animal prints are turning up on unexpected items: scaly snake texture on bags, shoes and blouses, and zebra challenging polka dots, including warm beige-gold or brown-burgundy versions.

trends.name: Diamond pattern with tiny florals
trends.summary: A baklava-style diamond geometric with small embroidered flowers is a key autumn motif, styled with leather gloves or with denim for a street look.

trends.name: Fine pinstripe tailoring
trends.summary: Thin, regular pinstripes return on tailored pieces, for example burgundy stripes on navy suits or two close tones combined.

trends.name: Western-inspired capsule
trends.summary: Trendyolmilla's late-October Western Edition offers suede and leather bombers, gingham and small-check shirts, fringe, beading and rivets, styled with cowboy hats and boots.

trends.name: Loose and barrel-leg trousers
trends.summary: Relaxed, loose-fitting and barrel-leg trousers anchor the Trendyolmilla Western Edition drop launched in October 2026.

trends.name: Coffee, tan and burgundy earth tones
trends.summary: The autumn western capsule works in an earthy range of coffee, tan, ecru, burgundy, khaki and denim blue.

trends.name: Craft as the future of luxury
trends.summary: Designer Murat Aytulum argues that luxury means building lasting value through handwork and well-made leather, using technology to extend craft rather than to raise output.

trends.name: Logos recede, quiet luxury returns
trends.summary: Turkish commentators see visible logos fading again amid social tension, with Gen Z scrutinising materials and supply chains and luxury redefined around time, privacy and ethics.

trends.name: Belted and scarf-collar coats
trends.summary: Winter guidance published in January 2026 pushed long voluminous coats cinched at the waist, coats with built-in scarf panels, and chunky knits over wide-leg trousers.

trends.name: Animal prints on padded outerwear
trends.summary: Leopard, zebra and cowhide moved from accents to main prints on padded coats and accessories in Turkish winter 2025-26 coverage.

trends.name: Deep forest green
trends.summary: Forest green was named the rising winter shade in December 2025, worn tone-on-tone or with beige, grey and gold as an alternative to black.

trends.name: Maximalism over capsule minimalism
trends.summary: Year-ahead coverage for 2026 predicted a move from minimal capsule wardrobes toward colour, scale and layering, with lace, brooches, deer motifs and khaki as a neutral.

trends.name: Fabric leads Turkish textile exports
trends.summary: Woven and knitted fabrics were the largest textile export group in January-September 2026 at about 4.35 billion dollars, with shipments to the US up around 18%.

trends.name: Technical textiles top export category
trends.summary: In the first half of 2026, technical textiles were Türkiye's biggest textile export group, ahead of woven fabrics and yarn; fabric and yarn exports to the US rose sharply.

trends.name: Sector recovery and design push
trends.summary: Officials say the textile and apparel slump has bottomed out in 2026; a new İHKİB innovation and design centre opened in Istanbul to raise export value.

trends.name: Premium home textiles
trends.summary: Türkiye, Europe's top home-textile exporter, is pushing into higher-value bedding, towels, upholstery, curtains and sustainable home lines, as showcased at HOMETEX 2026.

trends.name: Low-impact dyeing and washing
trends.summary: Texhibition Istanbul showcased sustainable denim washes, experimental dyeing, self-colouring cotton that cuts dye-house water and energy, and compostable pleated fabrics.

trends.name: Y2K denim and colour beyond indigo
trends.summary: Turkish denim mills report early-2000s fits returning with flatter surfaces, nature-inspired colours beyond indigo, and insulated plush or slub-effect constructions for colder seasons.

trends.name: Traceable bio and recycled cotton denim
trends.summary: Mill Iskur is building denim around organic cotton from its own land, recycled cotton and traceability data, plus a bio indigo said to resist yellowing.

trends.name: Functional, sustainable kidswear
trends.summary: The IFCO trade fair reported buyer demand for functional, sustainable and quality-focused baby and childrenswear in its kids section.

trends.name: Tesettür co-ord sets and trenches
trends.summary: 2025 modest coverage highlighted matching tunic-and-trouser sets in crepe and viscose, loose cuts, and belted trench coats in beige, stone and smoke grey with pastels gaining.

trends.name: Greeting-themed SS27 collection
trends.summary: Murat Aytulum's SS27 SELAM collection mixes traditional codes with contemporary cuts and technical textures, framed around migration, climate and digital life.

trends.name: IFCO February 2027 sourcing season
trends.summary: IFCO's next edition is listed for 3-6 February 2027; its seminar programme covers SS27-28 trends, and its trend area previewed AW27-28.

trends.name: Digital product passports from 2027
trends.summary: Experts quoted in Milliyet expect EU digital product passport rules from 2027 to push Turkish suppliers toward fuller supply-chain transparency.

trends.name: Zoomed florals and paisley revival
trends.summary: Global SS27 forecasts cite oversized florals, soft-focus prints and reworked paisley and animal skins; a general signal for Turkish womenswear, not Türkiye-specific.
